headers.im: Sirach cabu he a ngen long tah Thuituen Ol cabu a pabaenah la a ti uh. He kah cabu he Jesus Ben Sirach loh a tael coini a ti uh. Hebrew rhoek kah khokhuen cabu dongah koep a hmuh uh vaengah tah Eleazar Ben Sirach capa Jesuh casak Simon loh a tael coinih a ti uh. Simon he Hebrew hlang cueih khat la om tih anih he BC yacut panit tluk vaengah Jerusalem ah kho a sak. (Ecclus 50:27; cf. 51:23ff.). He kah cangpueinah dongah khak aka cak rhoek he a voelvai atah Saducean la om a ti. Hekah catael neh cangpueinah he Jews. Khat ben ah tah Olcueih (Proverb) cabu he ni a cak la koep a thuicaihnah ngaih la om. He kah a catael he sawt vaengah Jews hlang rhuem rhoek kah a tael longim bangla om. Jew rhoek neh Khristian rhoek long a phu a om sak uh. He cabu he BC 180 tluk vaengah a tael.

verses.text: \s1 Cueinah A Uem
Cueihnah boeih Boeipa lamkah tih. amah taengah a yoeyah la om.
\w Tuitunli\w* \w kah\w* \w laivin\w* \w khaw\w*, khotlan tuicip khaw, kumhal kah khohnin he u long a tae thai?
Vaan kah a sang neh, diklai kah a ka khaw, tangrhom kah a dung khaw u long a khe thai?
Cueinah he hno tloe cungkuem lakah a suen lamhma coeng,
yakmingnah neh mueltuetnah khaw khosuem kah pawn ni.
Cueihnah a yung tah u taengah nim a phoe? A langnah te uh long a ming?
Cueihnah mingnah he a phoe pah rhoek taengah om tih, aka yaakming rhoek taengah tah a coih la a hm uh.
Hlang pakhat om tih, anih tah cueih, bahoeng rhih ham aka om tah, A ngolkhoel dongah aka ngol Boeipa ni.
Amah loh cueihnah a suen tih, Te te a sawt phoeihah a nueh bal pueng, Te ni a bibinah boeih dongah a lun.

A kutdoe tarhing la mulhing boeih soah a paek tih, amah aka lungnah soah moeihoeih la a paek.   
\b  
\s1 Boeipa Rhih he Cueihnah ni
Boeipa rhihnah he thangpomnah neh pomsangnah, kohoenah neh omngaihnah rhuisam la om.
Boeipa rhihnah loh thinko a hmae sak tih, kohoenah, omngaihnah, hinglung vangnah a paek.
Boeipa aka rhih tah a bawtnah hil omngaih vetih, a dueknah hnin ah yoethennah om ni.
Boeipa rhihnah he tah cueihnah a tongnah ni, te te bungko khuiah khaw uepomnah neh a suen.
Cueihnah tah hlanghing lakli ah kumhal khoengim la a suen tih, a cadil lakli ah khaw uepom la rhaehrhong pawn ni.
Boeipa rhihnah loh cueihnah a baetawt sak, a thai te hlang a hah sak.
Im pum te ngaih om hno neh a bae sak tih, a khai te a thaih neh a khawk sak.
Boeipa rhihnah he cueihnah rhuisam la om, mongnah neh saitlimnah ham sadingah a paek.
Mingnah te a tlan sak tih nuemnainah te a ngaih sak, Amah aka tu rhoek kah thangpomnah te a sang sak.

Boeipa rhihnah tah cueinah a yung la om, a hlaeng khaw hinglung a vangnah la om.   
\b
Boeipa rhihnah long tah tholhnah a haek tih, amah dongah aka tukkai hlang a thintoeknah boeih a nong tak.
A thuem mueh kah thintoeknah he a thuem la a om moenih, cungnueh a bawtnah hil kah thintoeknah loh hlang a poci sak.
A thuemnah rhi hil kammueh la om tih aka ueh tah, amih te kohoenah loh koep a mael thil.

A thuemnah rhi hil a ol aka tuem rhoek tah, A yet kah hmuilai dongah amih kah a then te a thui.   
\b
Cueihnah thakvoh khuikah tah olthui khaw cueih, tedae hingcimnah he hlangtholh ham tah tueilaeh kap.
Cueinah te na ngaih tah olpaek te tuem, Boeipa loh nang soah a hmoek bitni.
Boeipa rhihnah tah cueihnah neh rhilam la om tih, uepomnah neh kodonah ni a ngaingaih.
Boeipa rhihnah te altha boel lamtah, lungbuei kaekvang neh amah te paan boeh.
Hlang tloe hmuh ah thailatnah neh om boeh, na hmuilai khaw dawn lamtah tuem.

Namah te pom uh soeh boeh, Na tla vetih nang soah mingthaenah la pai ve. Boeipa loh na olhuep khaw a phoe vetih, hlangping hmai ah nang m'palet ve. Boeipa rhihnah neh na lo pawt dongah, na thinko ah thailainah ni a bae.
Ka ca aw, Boeipa te thothueng ham na lo vaengah, namah noemcai hamla rhuengphong dae.
Na thinko te a dueng la khueh lamtah cak sak,
Amah te kop lamtah nong boeh, te daengah ni hnukhueng khohnin ah na thaihtak eh.
Na sokah aka tla sarhui te doe mai ngawn, tlayae tue vaengah khaw thinsen la om mai.
Sui khaw hmai neh a noemcai tih, doe koila a hmuh rhoek tah tlayaenah hmai neh a noemcai.
Amah te uepnah lamtah amah loh nang n'bom bitni, na longpuei mah a dueng la khueh lamtah amah te ngaiuep.
Boeipa aka rhih tih a rhennah aka rhing nang tah, phael boeh ne, na cungku tarha ve.
Boeipa aka rhih tih hno then aka ngaiuep nang tah, na kutdoe khaw hma mahpawh.

Boeipa aka rhih tih hnothen aka ngaiuep nang tah, omngaihnah neh sitlohnah khaw kuei ni.   
\b
Yankah rhuirhong te poek lamtah so lah, Boeipa dongah aka pangtung hlang he a ngaihlih bal nim? Boeipa rhihnah dongah aka tuem uh te a voeih bal nim? Amah aka khue te a hnalval nah bal pawn nim?

Boeipa tah thinphoei lungvat neh sitlohnah la om tih, tholnah khodawk a ngaih phoeiah, ngaihmang tue vaengah khaw a khang bal.   
\b
Anunae, rhalyawp thinko neh, yaikawt kut aih, caehlong panit ah aka cet hlangtholh aih te.
Anunae ko aka bawt tih pangtungnah aka khueh pawt aih te, Te dongah amih te hlipyingnah khueh mah pawh.
Anunae, nangmih yaknganah aka khueh pawt rhoek aih, Boeipa kah cawhnah a pai vaengah metlam na ti eh?
Boeipa aka rhih rhoek long tah a ol te a ngai pawt moenih, amah aka lungnah rhoek loh a khosing khaw a tuem.
Boeipa aka rhih loh \em Boeipa\em* kongaih ni a tlap tih, amah aka lungnah hlang tah a olkhueng neh baetawt.
Boeipa aka rhih long tah a thinko a rhoekbah tih, a mikhmuh ah amah te kunyun coeng.
Boeipa kut dongla tla uh sih lamtah, hlang kut dongah boel saeh. A boeilennah neh a sitlohnah he vanat tih, a ming neh a bibinah khaw vanat la om.
\s1 Manunapa Soah Khueh Ham Koi
Ka a rhoek aw, na pa kai ol he hnatun uh, a cuepmueih la pongtho lamtah, a suengnah la n'khoem saeh.
Boeipa loh ca rhoek soah a napa te a thangpom tih, ca rhoek soah saithainah khueh ham a manu te a cak sak.
Napa thangpom he tholh dawthnah la om tih,
A manu hinyahnah he tah kawn aka tung neh vai uh.
A napa aka thangpom hlang tah a ca rhangneh omngaih vetih, A thangthui uh vaengah khaw a hnatun pah ni.
Napa hinyahnah he tah hinglung vangnah la om tih, manu aka thangpom loh Boeipa ol te a ngai.
Te dongah a manu napa te a boei bangla bongyong saeh.
Na pa te ol neh, khoboe neh thangpom lah, te daengah nih a yoethennah te nang soah a pai eh.

Pa kah yoethennah loh ca rhoek kah im a thoh pah tih, manu kah thaephoeinah loh a khoengim a phil pah.   
\b
Na mah na thangpom neh na pakah mingthaenah saii boeh, na pa kah mingthaenah te nang thangpomnah moenih.

Ana pa kah thangpom nah khaw amah kah thangpomnah ni, te dongah a manu aka hinyahnah pawh camoe tah mingthae a phueih.   
\b
Ka ca aw, na pa te a patong vaengah khaw bom, a hing khui ah anih te kothet sak boeh.
a kopoek talh mai cakhaw a taengah thinsennah khueh mai, na thaomnah na khueh li vaengah khaw anih te hnoo boeh.
Pa taengah rhennah aka khueh tah hnilh pawt vetih, na tholhnah soah nang ham tholh hlahnah la om ni.
Nang kah citcai khohnin vaengah khaw, nang ham kolonah a poek vetih, khothen vaengkah cingmai bangla, na tholhnah khaw cing ni.

A napa aka hno he tah Pathen aka soehsalkung neh vai uh tih, A manu thintoek aka saii tah Boeipa loh thae a phoei thil.   
\b  
\s1 Kodonah
Ka ca, na hutnah te kodonah neh saii, Pathen aka doe rhoek long nang n'lungnah bitni.
Len la na om atah, namah te kodo la muep na om a kuek. Te daengah ni Boeipa Mikhmuh ah kolonah na dang eh.
Muep phoe uh tih yan uh mai cakhaw, kodo long ni olhuep a hmuh sak.
Lennah he khaw Boeipa kah a tlungthangnah tih, \em kodo\em* long tah Boeipa a thangpom.
Namah hamla aka kuel tloe te khaw tlap boel lamtah, na sarhi voelah aka om khaw khe boeh.
Nang hamla balae olpaek aka om tih, na ngoe mueh tah a thuh coeng mah thuep.
Nang voelkah olka dongah lai panit la phae sak boeh, na ming thai lakah a yet la nang te n'tueng coeng.

Amih kah kopoek loh longhmang la muep a mawt tih, poek tholnah loh a laitloeknah khaw a haeh sak coeng.   
\b
Ming a om pawt tah vangnah om pawh, mingnah a om pawt tah cueihnah om pawh.
Thin thah kah hmakhahnah khaw thae cakue tih, mueirhih aka lungnah khaw amah te ni a toh eh.
Lungbuei mangkhak he khaw ngaihmang loh a nan vetih, hlangtholh loh tholnah te tholhnah neh a koei.
Hlang oek te citcai loh a tlak thil vaengah, a hoeihnah om pawt tih, boethae thing te anih khuiah a yung cak.

Lungming kah lungbuei long tah thuidoeknah te a oep tih, hna aka kaeng tah cueih aka ngaih la om van.   
\b  
\s1 Khodaeng Bomnah
Hmai tak khui kah tui a rhaeng bangla, bomcennah khaw tholh dawthnah la om.

Kolonah neh aka pae loh hmailong ham khaw a paek, A cungku vaengah khaw aka duelkung a hmuh ni.   
\b
Kaca aw, khodaeng kah khosaknah te yoop boeh Vawtthoek mik neh aka rhing te khaw mangthung tak boeh.
Bungpong khaw kothet sak boel lamtah, aka vawtthoek khaw thintoek sak boeh.
Kobawt kah ngaihmangnah te koei pah boeh, aka vawtthoek khaw paek hamla uelh boeh.
Patang neh kutduen te khaw haek boel lamtah, khodaeng taeng lamloh na maelhmai mangthung boeh.
Aka vawtthoek taeng lamloh na mik a tloe ka hoi boeh, thang thaephoei thil ham rhoidoengnah khueh boeh.

Hinglu aka khahing loh nang n'tap vetih, Amih suenkung loh a thangthuinah te ya lah ve.   
\b
Hlangping taengah khaw namah rhoinaeng lah, hlang len taengah na lu khun sak mai.
Yaaknah te khodaeng ham khueh pah lamtah, amih kah voemtoeinah khaw olthen la thuung.
A hnaemtaek te hnaemtaekkung kut lamloh hlawt lamtah, amih te a tang paek hamla uelh boeh.

Cadah ham a napa la om pah lamtah, a manu taengah khaw a va bangla om pah. Te daengah ni Khohni capa la na om vetih, amah loh na nu lakah khaw n'lungnah eh.   
\s1 Cueinah Kutdoe
Cueinah loh a ca a thuituen tih, amah aka rhoek te bomnah a paek.
Amah aka lungnah loh hingnah khaw a lungnah tih, mingcang lamloh amah yueya aka tlap tah omngaihnah bae.
Amah khak a tu loh thangpomnah a pang tih, a kunnah hmuen te Boeipa loh yoethennah a paek.
Amah taengah tho a thueng te A cim Pathen ham ni, amah aka lungnah te Boepa loh a lungnah.
A ol aka ngai rhoek loh namtom lai a tloek vetih, te aka hnatun boeih tah hiluepnah neh hing ni.
Uepomnah neh aka tukkoei long te te a pang vetih, a tiingan long khaw te te a dang ni.

Caethae longpuei ah khaw amih taengah lamhma la cet vetih, amih soah rhinah neh lakuengnah khaw a khuen pah ni. Amih te nganboh nen khaw, amah a uepnah hil amih te a toel ni. Te phoeiah amih te a olrhi neh a noemcai ni.
Te phoeiah amih te long dueng la a mael puei vetih, ko a hoe sak phoeiah amih ham olhuep a phoe pah ni.

A phaelh la a caeh uh atah amih te a hnoo vetih, amih te a pocinah ham a voeih ni.   
\b
A tue then te dawn lamtah, boethae te rhalrhing,
namah te rhaidaeng la om saii boeh.
Namah aka ngawn hamla hlaangnah khueh khueh boeh, na tlaknah hamla a lang la om boeh.
A tuengnah dongah tah olcal khaw paih boeh, na cueinah khaw phah boeh.
Cueinah he khaw olthui thingka loh a mingpha sak tih, hmuilai dongkah ol he tah lungmingnah la om.
Oltak te oelh boeh, na kotalhnah he yah hamla om.
Na tholhnah te phong hamla yak boeh, tuiva kah tuithaa te mah hamla cai boeh.
Hlang ang taengah yalh pah boel lamtah, ukkung taengah hlaangnah khueh boeh.

Oltak ham te na dueknah hil hnuei lamtah, Boeipa Pathen loh nang yuengla a hnueih bitni.   
\b
Na olcal dongah buhueng pom boeh, na bibi dongah khaw yaikawt ngakyalnah khueh boeh.
Na imkhui ah sathueng bangla om boel lamtah, na tueihyoeih te ngaihoih boeh.
Dang ham bueng la na kut te phuel boel lamtah, paek ham tue vaengah khaw na kut poem boeh.
Na khuehtawn dongah hangdang boeh, “Ka rhoeh van coeng,” ti boeh.
Na ngainah neh thaomnah te vai boeh, na thiko kah a hue khaw hloem boeh.

“Kai soah unim thaomnah aka khueh,” ti boeh. Boeipa long namah te dan n'tat ve.   
\b
“Ka tholh, dae kai ham bala om pawh,” ti boeh, Boeipa loh thintoek khaw a ueh.
Khodawkngainah khaw uepnah aih boeh, Tholhnah te tholhnah nen ni na thap eh.
“A sitlohnah len tih, ka tholhnah ping cakhaw, khodawk a ngai ni,” ti boeh. Amah taengah kosi neh sitlohnah bok om lah ko, a thintoeknah he hlang tholh soah ni a tlak.
Boeipa taengla na mael ham te uelh boeh, hnin at phoeiah hnin at dang thil boeh. Pathen kah kosi te nang soah buengrhuet ha tla vetih, dantatnah hnin at na mit na moeng ve.

Laithae khuehtawn dongah hangdang boeh, citcai tue ah na hoeikhangnah om hae mahpawh.   
\b
Kho a hli takuem khaw cang hla boeh, caehlong khaw boeih vai boeh
Na mingnah soah a cak la pai lamtah, na olthui khaw a cip la om saeh.
Hnatun ham tah loe sak lamtah, hlatnah ham tah a yaila poek.

Thui ham te na ming atah na imben mah hlat pah, na pawt atah na ka te na kut neh buem thil.   
\b
Hinyahnah neh mingthaenah khaw olthui lamloh thoeng tih, hlang kah lai he amah a tlaknah la om.
A lai ka phae tila n'khue uh boel saeh, na lai te hlaeh la tung boeh. Huen lamloh yahpohnah thoeng tih, a lai aka phae he tah a boe hamla tueng mai.
A len khaw, a yit akhaw, dumlai he tah nganboh la om het mahpawt nim?

Paya te rhal la lat khueh boeh, mingthae he khaw yahpohnah neh yan uh khoeng, Te dongah hlangtholh lai phae khaw te tlam ni a om.   
\b
Hoehhamnah khuiah khaw khak cungpung boeh, vaito bangla maehpoel la n'sah ve.
Na hnah te han luep vetih na thaih te ham phae ve, Te vaengah thing koh bangla nang n'hno hae ve.

Boethae kah hoehhamnah aka khueh a phae vetih, amih te a thunkha kah nueihbu la a poeh sak ni.   
\b  
\s1 Paya Tang
Ol then loh paya a ping sak tih, lai aka phaih loh boethen a yet sak.
Paya he na taengah muep om mai saeh, Tedae thawng khat dongah pakhat ni baerhoep la a om eh.
Paya la khueh na ngaih vaengah khaw, nuemnai lamtah khueh amih te cukhat la uepnah boeh.
Amih te paya lamkhaw boeih koih uh suidae, na patang tue ah tah nang n'om puei hae mahpawh.
Paya khaw thunkha la poeh vetih, tohhaemnah te rhaidaeng la a thui ni.
Na caboei aka vael na paya rhoek khaw, na ngaihmang tue vaengah tah pai hae mahpawh.
Na khueh na tawn vaengah tah na pum pabae la om vetih na tueiyoeih rhoek soah boei khaw a bi ni.
Tedae na tlak vaengah tah, nang taeng lamloh mael uh vetih, nang te n'thuh uh tak ni.

Na thunkha rhoek taeng lamloh lakhla khoem uh lamtah, na paya rhoek taengah khaw hueltue la ngaithuen.   
\b
Paya uepom tah hmuencak kah hlipyingnah la om tih, kawnthen aka hmuh rhoek bangla om.
Uepom paya tah a puehsoi la a phu om tih, U long khaw a phu a ting la thui thai mahpawh.
Paya he hingnah aka hlawt si la om tih, Boeipa aka rhih long ni te te a hm uh.

Boeipa aka rhih long tah paya khaw a then la a hoihaeng, amih vanbangla a imben soah khaw om.   
\b  
\s1 Cueihnah Yoethen
Ka ca aw, na camoe lamkah toelnah te tuek lah, na sam a pok vaengah khaw cueihnah na dang pueng ni.
Te te lotawn cangtuh bangla ha thoeng tih, cangah tue then a lamtawn. Lo na phoh vaengah kolkalh tah na thakthae dae, a thaih te pahoi na caak pawn ni.
Te te bahoeng ngakyal ham khaw om dae, a taengah anglatnah a naeh thai moenih.
Te tah lungto aka rhih bangla a noem dongah, phawn a voeih ham te uelh mahpawh.

Cueihnah he a ming nen khaw a tluk dongah, muep a doe uh ham khaw sikim uh thai pawh.   
\b
Ka ca, hnatun lamtah, ka laitloeknah he doe lah, ka cilkhih he khaw hnawt boeh.
A khocin dongah na kho te thawt lamtah, a rhawnmoep dongah na rhawn te khueh lah.
Na laeng te duen lamtah amah te kawt lah, amah kah pinyennah khuiah khaw omdam boeh.
Na hinglu boeih neh amah te paan lah, na thaomnah boeih neh a longpuei te ngaithuen lah.
Khe lamtah tlap lah, na hmuhkoi la ha om bitni, amah te na tuuk coeng atah hlah voel boeh.
A hnukkhueng ah tah duemnah m'paek vetih, nang ham omngaihnah la poeh ni.
A palawm pataeng sui himbai la poeh tih, amah pinyinah khaw daidi haikang la poeh.
A rhoeplong tah sui thoeihcamnahnah la om tih, a haikang khaw daidi rhui bangla om.

Amah te thangpomnah hnikul la na bai vetih, amah te boeilennah rhuisam la na khuem bitni.   
\b
Na huem atah, ka ca nang te n'toel vetih, namah hamla na loh atah aka khuel la na om ni.
Hnatun hamla na lungnah van atah mingnah na dang vetih,
hna na kaeng van atah hlangcueih la na poeh ni.
Hingcim dongkah thuingongnah tah hnatun hamla sikim lamtah, hlangcueih kah thuidoeknah loh nang n'rhael boel saeh.
Lungming hlang te na hmuh atah yue thoo lamtah lai-om, na khopha te a kuihlak dongah daeptlawt saeh.
Boeipa kah olrhi te poek lamtah, a olpaek boeih khaw a tue takuem ah thuep lah. Amah loh na lungbuei kah hmuhmingnah m'paek vetih, cueihnah na hue te khaw m'paek bitni.
Boethae na saii boel lamtah, boethae long khaw nang m'vuei boel saeh.
Tholhdalh te a hla om tak lamtah, amah te nang lamloh nong bitni.

Boethae kah hmakhuen dongah cangti soem boeh, a cangvuei te voeirhih la na yun het mahpawt nim?   
\b
Hmuen sang lamkah Boeipa neh, Manghai taengkah thangpomnah ngolhmuen te toem boeh.
Na duengnah te Boeipa hmaiah thaem boel lamtah, na cueihnah khaw manghai hmuh ah tai boeh.
Laitloekkung la om ham khaw tlap soeh boeh, dumlai kah a yung ka phil tloel la na om ve. Thaomnah kah a hnaephnap la na om vetih, na cuepmueihnah khaw yip muei ve.

Hlangping soah boekoeknah saii boel lamtah, pilnam taengah namah te rhaidaeng la om boeh.   
\b
Dantatnah na yook pawt mai cakhaw, tholhnah he a rhaep la koep saii voel boeh.
“Ka kutdoe muep a yet he a poek vetih, Khohni Pathen taengah nawnnah ka paek te, a doe bitni,” ti boeh.
Na thangthui vaengah na mawnnah te pueh boeh, doedanah paek ham khaw hnoelrhoeng boeh.
Mueihla dikdak aka khahing hlang te hnael boeh, Tlayae phoeiah aka thangpom kung om.
Na manuca te laithae neh dum boeh, na paya khaw amah te tlam te saii boeh.
Laithae boeih tah ngaih loengloeng boeh, te bang khoboe kah a thaih tah a then ka moenih.

A hamca rhoek ngoltunnah khuiah bawlh bawlh tlawk boeh, na thangthui vaengah khaw namah loh koep khoep boeh.   
\b
Bi rhuh neh, lotawn bi khaw thinah boeh, Te te Khohni long ni a suen coeng.
Hlangtholh rhoek kah rhaenghmuen ah khaw thum boeh, amih a thungnah a koe moenih tila poek.

Namah te a dangdik hil khaw yalh mai, lailak ham dantatnah tah hmai neh keet ni a om coeng.   
\b  
\s1 A Tloe Neh Tukkainah
Paya te khaw tangka la yoi boeh, Manuca tak tah Ophir sui banghui pawn ni.
Lungcuei neh huta then te hnoo boeh, a muelhtuetnah tah sui lakah ting ngai.
Uepom la bi aka bi sal te khaw, a bibi dongah aka tlungmu kutloh hlang te hnaep boeh.
Na hinglu loh lungming sal te lungnah saeh lamtah, amih kah a loeihnah ham khaw hloh boeh.
Saelhung na khueh atah a then la ngaithuen, na hoeikhangnah hang khuen khuitah a then la khoem.
Na ca a noe vaengah na ol a ngai hamla amih te thutuen lah.

Halhka ka a mik tah a maeh ham soah a ngaikhuek ti pawh, Te dongah halka long he hinglu ni a rhae sak.
Moeithae loh a buh khaw a hnaih dongah a caboeih khaw kaksap la a khueh.
Ka ca, na coengnah tarhing he hnothen neh phaep uh, Boeipa taengah nawnnah te khaw a koihnilh la pae.
Dueknah he tah a koe moenih nih tila poek. Te dongah Saelkhui kah kah oltloeknah khaw n'tueng hlan.
Na duek hlanah na paya ham a then saii pah, kut yueng lamtah na coeng thai khuiah anih te doedan lah.
Hnin at kah kohoenah dongah namah poeih uh boeh, boethen la doe na ngaih kah buhham te khaw hlong boeh.
Na thakthae kah a thaihtae te hlang tloe ham caeh tak hae mahpawt nim? Te dongah thakthae neh na vawtthaih dueng khaw Taelcung neh tael uh thae hae ni ta.
Pae lamtah, lo lamtah na pum khaw dom mai dae Saelkhui ah pangdoknah pakhat long khaw a hmuh moenih.
Mulhing boeih he himbai rhuem bangla om coeng, a rhuem lamkah oltloeknah long nah, “Na duek kuekluek ni” a ti.
Thing phung dongkah a hnah a bu bangla a hlip loh a tloe soah a huep. Te dongah thii neh pumsa kah tiingan la aka om tah pakhat a duek vaengah pakhat tloep thaang.

Bibi boeih khaw hmawn vetih aka om ham khaw muei ni, te te aka saii khaw amah te nen te khum ni.   
\b  
\s1 Cueihnah Dongah Omngaihnah
Cueinah neh lungming poeknah aka thuep tah a yoethen.
Anih long tah a lungbuei khosing neh, a huep kah te khaw a boelh.
Cueihnah te sayuep bangla a vai tih, a namtlak ah a mah.
Bangbuet longah a dawn tih a thohka ah a hnatun.
A im taengah a rhaeh thil tih, a pangbueng dongah hlingcong khak a khing.
Cueihnah taengah dap te a tuk, Te dongah impah hmuen khaw a then tloe a dang.
A ca rhoek te a hlipkhup ah a khueh tih, a thingbu hmuiah duemdong coeng.
Kholing vaengah khaw a khuiah ying tih, thangpomnah lakli ah kho a sak.
Boeipa aka rhih long tah he ni a saii eh, Tedongah olkhueng aka pom long tah cueihnah a dang ni.
Cueihnah tah anih aka doe a manu bangla a caeh pah vetih, anih te yulokung cadong bangla a doe ni.
Cueihnah loh anih te cangnah buh a tuh vetih, anih te cueihnah tui ok hamla a paek ni.
Anih tah cueihnah dongah hangdang vetih bung mahpawh. Anih te cueihnah dongah pangnal vetih yah pok mahpawh.
Cueihnah loh anih te a hui soah a pacuet vetih, hlangping lakli ah khaw a ka a ang ni.
Anih tah kohoenah neh omngaihnah rhuisam a hmuh vetih, dungyan kah ming then te khaw a pang ni.
Hlang ang loh cueihnah te dang pawt vetih, hlang tholh loh cueihnah te hmu mahpawh.
Cueihnah tah mangkhak taeng lamloh lakhla vetih, laithae khaw cueinah loh a poek mahpawh.
Hlangtholh rhoek kah hmuilai ah koehnah khaw cuen pawh Amih te boeipa taeng lamloh han tuei pai moenih.

Cueinah dongah koehnah khaw thoeng pai saeh, Te dongah Boeipa long ni tluep naep sak saeh.   
\b  
\s1 Sayalhnah
“Ka cungkunah ham Boeipa loh a saii,” ti boeh. A thinah hno te a saii moenih.
“Amah loh kai khohmang la m'mawt,” ti boeh, Tholh he a ngoenah a om moenih.
Boeipa loh konawhnah boeih he a thinah, te bang te amah aka rhih loh a lungnah moenih.
A tongcuek kah hlang a suen vaengah te te ana om coeng, sayalh la tuek thainah khuiah ni hlang te ana khueh.
Na tuek coeng tah olpaek te khaw na tuem thai van vetih, Sayalh la tuek thainah olka dongah uepom la na saithani ni.
Nang hmai ah tui neh hmai khaw a khueh, mebang na tuek ham akhaw na kut yueng laeh.
Hlang takuem kah hingnah neh dueknah soah pakhat rhip loh a tuek bangla a paek bitni.
Boeipa kah cueihnah tah len tangkik, a thaomnah khaw khuet tih a cungkuem a hmuh thai.
A mik te amah aka rhih taengah a paelki tih, hlang kah pongthohnah boeih a ming.
Pakhat khaw halang hamla ol a paek moenih, te dongah pakhat khaw tholh saithainah a paek moenih.
\s1 Hlangtholh Soah Pathen Kah Toelnah
Camoe yoka te muep ngaih boeh, lailak cadil soah khaw kohoe sak boeh.
Amih te a ping mai akhaw amih te uem boeh, amih khuiah Boeipa aka rhih a om hae pawt atah.
Amih kah thingthuelnah dongah pangtung boel lamtah, a hlangmi dongah khaw hangdang poeh. Pakhat he khaw thawngkhat lakah then thai tih, lailak ca khueh lakah tah cakol la duek he then ngai.
Rhung tue pawt ah na nguek uh hae vetih, buengrhuet a hmata uh te ni na ming hae eh.
Ka mik loh te bang hno te muep a hmuh coeng, he lakah langya ngai hno khaw ka hna loh a yaak coeng
Hlangtholh rhoek tingtunnah he tah hmai hlup banghui la om, Altha namtu taengah khaw kosi rhong ni.
Amah kho khosuen hlangtlung khaw khodawk a ngai moenih, amih te a tlung neh boe a koek uh dongah.
Amah loh Lot kah imben rhoek khaw a hnaih moenih, amih kah a thilen te a tuei dongah.
Namtu a cungku soah khaw lungma a ti voel moenih, Amih kah tholhnah te a toeng uh pawt dongah.
Rhalkap thawng ya rhuk te khawm ta a thinthah neh a tingtun uh dongah ni a phae.
Thinthah hlang pakhat khaw om mai tih, dantat mueh la om koinih tih khobae rhambae la om ni. Boeipa taengah rhennah neh kosi khaw om, amah loh a rhen thai bangla kosi khaw a hong thai.
A rhennah bangla a phaepnah khaw len bal Hlang he a khoboe tarhing ah lai a tloek.
Hlang tholh he kutbuem nen khaw loeih pawt vetih, Hlang cim kah uehnah te khaw hnawt bal mahpawh.
Rhennah bibi boeih soah a hmuen a khueh tih, pakhat rhip loh a khoboe tarhing ah a doe.
Boeipa loh Pharaoh thin a len sak tih amah te hmat pawh, Tedae vaan hmuiah tlungthang la bi a bi ngaih dongah ni.
A sitlohnah he tah a saihluen boeih teaengah tueng tih, a rhilam rhui neh khoyin khothaih khaw boeih a rhi.
“Boeipa taeng lamloh ka thuh uh coeng, hmuen sang lamkah u long nim a lungbuei ah kai n'khueh eh. Pilnam te yet lakli ah u long kai m'ming, saihluen toeklek na mueh kai he bang lam ka om?” ti boeh.
Anunae, vaan neh vaan sosang aih, tangrhom dung neh diklai khaw, Boeipa loh a hip vaengah tah thuen uh coeng.
Tlang neh diklai khoengim khaw, liva neh lingluei khaw a so lamloh a sawt coeng.
He a lungbuei neh aka pha hlang a om moenih, a khosing te uh long a thui thai lek eh?
Hli thae te aka hmuh thai a om pawt bangla, a bibi khaw a kum ngai tah boeih a phah oeng.
A khoboe tiktamnah te thui hamla unim aka om tih, te rhoek te u long a rhing thai pai eh? A oltloek he tah bahoeng hla rhoe pai ta.

Te rhoek te yakingnah aka voei rhoek kah poeknah ni kotalh neh longphaelh hlang kah poeknah tah hlang ang ni.   
\b  
\s1 Suencuek Dongkah Pathen Cueihnah
Ka ca aw hnatun lamtah mingnah la lo lah, ka ol he rhep hnatun ham pae lah.
Thuituennah he tluektluek bitni, Te dongah mingnah he phekphek thui.
A tongcuek lamkah a bibi dongah Boeipa loh a suen Te a saii vaengah a rhimong khaw a suem coeng.
A bibi te dungyan kah olkhueng neh a soepsoei coeng, a uknah he khaw cadilcahma boeih ham pawn ni. Amih te ponghalh uh pawt tih tawnba uh pawh Te dongah a hmakhuen khaw toeng uh pawh.
Amih te pakhat loh pakhat kalthalh la nen pawt tih, amih te Boeipa ol te aek uh tlaih pawh.
Te vaengah Boeipa loh diklai a sawt thuk coeng, Te dongah amah kah hnothen nen khaw a baetawt sak.
Diklai he mulhing hui boeih neh a thing tih, Te rhoek khaw diklai la mael uh.
Boeipa loh hlang hing diklai lamloh a suen tih, amih te diklai la koep a mael sak.
Amih te a khohnin khaw rhep a khueh pah coeng, Tedae diklai dongah cungkuem boeih soah saithainah a khueh pah.
Amih te a khuiah amah bangla thaomnah a khueh pah tih, amih te amah mueiloh la a suen.

Amah loh mulhing boeih kah ko khuiah hlang rhihnah a khueh pah, Ramsa neh vaa soah uknah khaw hlang taengah a paek.   
\b
Te rhoek loh Boeipa loh yaknganah panga a paek, a parhuknah dongah tah hmatthainah, A parhihnah dongah a thuicaihnah ham mingnah a paek.
Hlang taengah boesoepnah, lai neh mik khaw, hna neh poeknah ham lungbuei khaw a paek.
Hlang dongah mingnah neh yakmingnah a bae sak tih, a thae neh a then khaw a tueng.
Boeipa rhihnah he amah loh hlang thinko ah a khueh pah, A bibi dongkah a khuetnah te khaw hlang a hmuh sak coeng.
A mih loh a cuenah dongkah a ming cim te a koeh tih,
a bibi aka nguel coeng te khaw phong uh saeh.
Amah loh hlang soah mingnah te a up tih, hingnah olkhueng te a yo sak.
Amah loh hlang taengah dungyan paipi a sai tih, A taengah a oltloek te a phoe pah.
Hlang mik loh Boeipa kah a boeimang thangpomnah a hmuh tih, a hna long khaw thangpomnah ol te a yaak coeng.
Hlang taengah, “A thae boeih te ngaithuen,” a ti nah. Te dongah a imben kawng dongah khaw olpaek te rhip a paek.
Hlang kah longpuei teh Boeipa taengah phoe yoeyah, te dongah a mikhmuh lamloh thuh uh thai pawh.
A camoe lamkah a khoboe rhoe mah a thae la hoi uh coeng, a thiko lungto bangla aka ning te khaw, ngasen lungbuei la a coeng sak uh thai moenih.
Amah loh namtom boeih kah ukkung a khueh, Tedae Israel tah Boeipa amah kah hamsum la om.
Amih kah bibi te Boeipa mikhmuh ah khomik bangla phaeng tueng. Amih kah khoboe Boeipa mik dongah boeih om.
Amih kah boethae boeih te Boeipa hmuh ah a thuh tloel, Te dongah amih kah tholhnah tah Boeipa taengah phoe.
Boeipa amah tah a then dongah Amih te metla a suen khaw boeih a ming tih hnawt mahpawh, Voei bal pawt vetih amih te a rhen bal pueng ni.
Doedannah aka khueh tah Boeipa taengah, kutbuen kutnoek bangla om tih. A sitloh hlang te tah a mik dongkah thaihthawn la, amah loh loh a khoem a bael ni.
Te phoeiah amih te a thoh vetih a thung pueng ni, Te vaengah amih tholhphu te amih lu soah a tloeng pah ni.

Te cakhaw aka yut rhoek tah a taengla a mael sak tih, Ngaiuepnah aka bawt rhoek khaw koep a hloep.   
\s1 Yutnah Ham Khuenah
Boeipa taengla mael lamtah na tholhnah te voei laeh, a mikhmuh ah thangthui lamtah na khoboe khaw hlawt laeh,
Khohni taengla mael lamtah boethae lamloh mael laeh, Amah loh a tuei te tah thinah saloel laeh.
Saelkhui ah u long Khohni koehnah a sak vetih, mulhing rhoek kah a hmuen ah u long a uem eh?
Duek lamkah he tah aka om mueh taengkah bangla uemnah he khaw paltham mai ta. Aka hing rhoek long tah Boeipa koehnah khaw a then la a sak.
Boeipa kah rhennah neh a taengla aka mael rhoek ham, khodawkngainah he len tangkik rhoe pai.
Hlanghing kah a noengnah he a cungkuem moenih, te dongah hlanghing puet aka nguel la om pawh.
Khomik lakah balae aka sae bal voel? Te pataeng hmuep pueng ta. Pumsa neh thii aisat he boethae long la a hmil.
Boeipa tah vaan sosang kah caempuei rhalboei ni. Tedae hlang hing boeih tah laipi hmaiphu la om.
Yoeyah la aka hing mah loh lunglai boeih a suen, Boeipa bueng ni tiktam la aom.
A kut dongkah canghloeng neh diklai a kilh, Te dongah cungkuem loh Boeipa ol te a ngai.
A thaomnah dongah hno cungkuem kah manghai la om tih, A cim boeih te a tihnai khui lamloh a paek a boe.
A bibi te doek hamla u khaw thaomnah a paek moenih, U long khoboe aka khuet te a thuep thai eh?
Boeimang thaomnah te u long a nueh thai? A rhennah te u long boeih a tae thai eh?
Te rhoek te thap neh yueh ham khaw a coeng moenih, Boeipa kah khobae rhambae te tah ham khaw coeng pawh.
Hlang kah hmakhah la a om vaengah, a tongnah lam ni a om uh. Duem uh coeng a ti vaengah, a lukil uh pueng.
Hlang he metlam a om ti, amih te metlam a hnonah A khui ah balae a then aka om tih, balae aka thae?
A hinglung a sen tloe om cakhaw, kum yakhat ni a pha coeng atah khotoe coeng.
Tuitunli kah tui cip neh \w laivin\w* laivai bangla, kumhal khohnin he tah kum setca mai ni.
Te dongah ni amih taengah Boeipa loh a thinsen tih, amih soah a rhennah a lun pah.
Hlang kah a bawtnah he citcai la a om khaw, amih loh a hmuh tih a hmat. Te dongah ni amih taengah khodawkngainah te cungkuem la muep a khueh pah.

Hlang kah thinphoei lungvat tah imben hambueng la om, Boeipa kah thinphoei lungvat tah mulhing boeih ham la om. Te dongah amih te a ho tih, a hlinsai tih, a thuituen, Te phoeiah tudawn bangla a tuping te a mael puei.

Amah kah rhilam aka doe boeih neh a khosing dongah aka tlungmu rhoek soah thinphoei lungvat a khueh.   
\b  
\s1 Aka Thuem Doedannah Kopoek
Ka ca, na khoboe then te hohmunnah neh thoek boeh, na kutdoe te khaw ol ling neh poeih boeh.
Kholing kholai khaw buemtui loh a dingsuek sak, Te dongah ol then he kutdoe lakah then ngai.
Ol ding he tah kutdoe then lakah oe ngai, Te rhoi te tah moeihoeih taengah ni m'hm uh.

Hlang ang long tah moeihoeih pawt la a khotoh nah, kopoek thae kah kutdoe loh hlang mik a hmaang sak.   
\b  
\s1 Cuepnnah
Na thui hlanah cang lamhma dae, na tloh hlanah na sadingnah te ngaithuen.
Laitloeknah a pai hlanah namah nuemnai uh, N'cawh tue vaengah khodawkngainah na hmuh bitni.
Boethae na puei hlan ah tlayae lamhma dae, Te daengah ni na tholh lamloh na yut thai eh.
Olhlo na khueh phetlet vaengah kanghalhnah om boelsaeh, te lamloh na loeih ham khaw an dueknah hil rhing aih boeh.
Ol na hlo hlanah namah te rhoekbah uh laeh, Boeipa aka noemcai hlang bangla om boeh.
Boeipa kah kosi ne dueknah hnin kah hamla poek, Tawnlohnah hnin tah a maelhmai te a hoi pawn ni.
Khobuh tue vaengah khokha tue khaw poek, Khuehtawn khohnin ah khodaeng neh vawtvainah khaw poek.
Mincang lamloh hlaem duela a hmuethma thovael uh, Boeipa mikhmuh ah a cungkuem he vil khoe uh.
Aka cueih tah cungkuem dongah a ngai-huet, Tholhnah loh boeih vael cakhaw, a thae khui lamloh tuem uh.
Lungming hlang long tah cueihnah a ming, Te donah cueinah aka hmuh te a koeh uh.

Olka aka ming thai tah amah khaw cueih, Te dongah thuidoeknah khaw a tha thai.   
\b  
\s1 Kuemsuemnah
Na kongaih te vai boel lamtah, na huengaih te khaw tuem mai.
Na hinglu te namah kongaih bueng na vai sak koinih, na thunkha rhoek kah nueibu la na om ni.
Pangdoknah dongah khaw hmae aih boeh, vaksaknah loh khodaeng la n'khueh ve.
Na sungkoi te a hong la na khueh vaengah tangka pu neh kho na tue koinih, buhbih la na om het mahpawt nim?
He tla aka saii hlang tah boei la om mahpawh, a yol khaw aka sawtsit tah a yol a yol ah voevoeh daeng ni.
Yu neh huta long he lungming khaw kho a hmaang sak, Pumyoi neh aka bol hlang khaw kutvit la poeh.

A koerang te yoop neh phol loh a rhawt pah vetih, kutvit hlang te tah boeih a yoop ni.   
\b  
\s1 Cal Suilaih Boeh
Hlang tloe tlek aka tangnah aih tah kopoek bawn tih, Aka tholh hlang khaw amah ni a tholhdalh sak.
Halangnah dongah aka omngaih tah boe yoeyah vetih Olka aka tuem hlang dingsuek la kho a sak ni.
Hlang thet aka thinah hlang tah, boethae khaw yol van ni.
Olca te koep khoep voel boeh, a cungkuem dongah na sudaeh voel mahpawh.
Na paya taengah khaw, rhal taengah khaw puen boeh, nang te n'tholh sak pawt atah te te phoe boeh.
Pakhat long khaw ya koinih nang n'dawn vetih, a tue a pha vaengah tah nang te n'thiinah ni.
Khat khat na yaak te namah taengah duek saeh, Rhal then sak te long te nang n'pook sak mahpawh.
Hlang ang loh tah khat khat a yaak vaengah, Huta camoe aka om bangla ca om bungtloh loh a kolek.
Palaa loh hlang phaitu a kah bangla hlang ang khuiah he thetnah ni a om.
Paya te dawt lah, anih loh saii pawt khaming, a saii oeh tah, koep saii voel boel saeh.
Na hui khaw dawt lah, anih loh thui pawt khaming, a thui oeh atah, koep koei voel boel saeh.
Paya khaw ol aka saii noek te tah rhep dawt, te dongah na yaak sarhui te boeih tangnah boeh.
Hlang a cai muehla paloe thai ta, Olcal aka tholh mueh hlang he a om moenih.
Amah te na cawh hlanah na imben khaw dawt dae, Te te Khohni kah olkhueng nen mah laitloek saeh.
Boeipa rhihnah tah lunghoihnah a kung la om, Te dongah cueinah loh Boeipa kah lungnah a dang sak.

Boeipa kah olkhueng mingnah long tah Khosaknah a rhimong te a paek tih, Omngaih la aka vai hlang long tah, hingnah thing thai dognah a kohoe.   
\b  
\s1 Cueihnah Taktak
Boeipa rhihnah tah cueihnah a cuinah la om tih, olkhueng soepsak long he cueihnah a cung sak.
Halang kah mingnah he tah cueihnah moenih, hlang tholh rhoekkah cilsuep dongah cuepmueihnah a om moenih.
Te te tueilaeh aka kap cueinah la om tih cueihnah a vawt coeng tah hlang ang lamni a poeh.
Yakmingnah loh vawt dae Pathen aka rhih he tah, Mingnah muep sang tih olkhueng aka phaelh lakah then.
Cuei hueltue mai cakhaw a tiktamnah a om pawt atah, Dumlai te na hamla a kolo neh pilnam aka phae la khoeng om.
Hlang thae te bakop tih nguekcoi sitoe cakhaw, A khui ah thailatnah hoengla baetawt.
A mael hmai a buenglueng tih hnatun khaw ngaih pawh. Tedae khat long a ming pawt vaengah tah, nang soah lamhma hang hul ni.
A thadueng vawt sitoe cakhaw anih te hlang tholh la khueh, A tuethen a dang atah boethae saii hamla tonga mahpawh.
Hlang he a sohman mueimae dongah phoe mai, aka khuel hlang he khaw, maelhmai rhoi a hum vaengah mingpha la om mai coeng.
Hlang a nueih cal dongah khaw, a pongthoh dongah khaw, a pueinak dongah khaw u lae tila mingpha mai.
A tuetang mueh la hlang aka ho khaw om, Tedae kammueh la aka om hlang tah cueih.
Poi uengkueng lakah khaw ho phetlet khaw hno then pakhat la om van mai.
Amah tholh aka ming tah yahpok mahpawh.
Lunguen doela a then aka saii hlang he tah, tildil hlang loh hula poeih ham a hue neh vai uh.
Pilnam a ngen duem a om te hlang cueih la om tih, ol aka yet he tah hlang loh a tuei.
Pilnam a ngen tah a thui a om pawt dongah duem om, Te vaengah a ngen tah thui a ming pawt dongah duem om bal.
A tuengtang buelh a pha hlan atah hlang cueih he duem om, Hlang ang kah a hoem long tah a tuetang then a hlong sak.

Muep aka cal khaw tuei ham om tih, anaa amah ngaih la aka hnonah khaw thiinah ham om.   
\b  
\s1 Benbo Benpang
Rhainah khuikah hlang he a hmailong then dae, A cuhunah vaengah tah sungdaeh la a thoeng sak.
Kapaiah he nang ham hoeikhangnah om pawh, kapbaih he tah rhaepnit la thung ham ni a om.
Thangpomnah dongah aka palyal khaw om tih, a ngentah a tlayae hmuen lamloh kut a thoh thai.
A ngen loh tangka a yol neh muep a lai, Tedae voei rhih lah koep lai a sah.
Hlang cueih he ol yol dae lungloeinah kap tih, hlang ang kah olcal thingka tah a poeyoek mai ni.
Hlang ang kah kutdoe nang hamla a hong ni, anih te buhungnah voeirhih la dang ham ni a dan.
A yol a paek nen khaw muep a palawh tih, a ka te konglawng bangla a ang soeh. Tihnin ah hlang a pu tih a vuen ah tlek a suk, Te bang hlang te Pathen neh hlang loh a thiinah.
Hlang ang long tah “Paya om pawh” ka boethen khaw hlang loh uem pawh, ka buh aka ca nawn long khaw olthae la kai n'thui,” a ti ni.

Anih te hlang loh meyet hil nim a nueih nah ve. Anih long te a huen hno ni a khueh, amah loh a khueh pawt tetah thae la a thui.   
\s1 Olhmang
Cirhong dongah paloe he hmuilai dongah paloe lakah then. Halang kah a cungkunah tah koeloe phoe,

Tedae amih long ni diklai kah rhoengnah a khoembael tih, Te dogah a ngaihuetnah ngawn tah thenpom bibi ham ni, Te dongah hlang amah pum a hloeh la lang van.
Amih long tah hlamat lamkha cueihnah a tlap, tonghma olthui te khaw a paelki.
Mingthang kah olthui khaw a khoem tih, thuidoeknah olkhoelh nen khaw phaep uh.
Olcueih kah thuingainah olhuep a tlap tih, im ah khaw thuidoeknah olkael neh om.
Anih tah hlanglen taengah khaw olpai thai tih ukkung rhoek hmaiah khaw pumphoe thai. Kholong kho la yiin tih, hlanghing kah hmulung a thae then khaw a ming.
Anih tah yueya thoh hamla thinko a khueh tih, Amah aka suenkung Boeipa tlap ham neh, Khohni taengah huithuinah khuen hamla. Thangthuinah ne a ka te a ang tih, a tholhnah dongah tholhhlahnah a bih.
Boeilen Boeipa loh a ngaih pa atah anih te yakmingnah mueihla a baetawt vetih, amah kah cueihnah loh te a thaa ni, thangthuinah neh Boeipa te a uem.
Boeipa loh a cilsuep neh mingnah a thuinuet vetih Boeipa kah olhuep aka thuep la om ni.
Anih te a cangnah soah cueihnah a tueng vetih, Boeipa paipi kah olkhueng dongah a thangpom ni.
A yakmingnah te muep a uem uh vetih, anih te hnawt uh tlaih voel mahpawh. Anih poekkoepnah te paa tlaih pawt vetih, a ming khaw cadilcahma boeih taengah hing ni.
A cueihnah te hamtom loh a thui vetih, anih koehnah te paeng loh a doek ni.

A hing khuiah khaw thawngkhat lakah ming tanglue a khueh ni, duemnah te paan cakhaw anih ham ta rhoeh coeng.   
\b  
\s1 Pathen Koehnah Laa
Ka lungbuei loh phoe a ngaih muep om, Hla lum bangla ka lumkil coeng.
Ka ca uepom neh pailum aw, hnatun lah, soca tuikaeng kah a poe rhaipai kung bangla.
Hmueihtui bangla botui hlah laeh, Tuilipai bangla na pailum laeh.
A ming te tanglue la khueh lamtah amah koehnah neh a taengah uemnah khueh laeh.
Boeipa kah bibi tah boeih then tangkik, A thui boeih te a tue a pha caengah thoeng yoeyah.
“He tah balae”, “Ke tah balae,” a ti thai moenih, a tue a pha vaengah te oldawtnah khaw boeih a hlat. A ol loh tui khaw puluk la a pai sak, a ol a ka dongah tuitungim kah tui khaw om.
Ol a paek vaengah a mangtaengnah boeih soep, khangnah thadueng khaw u loh a khaih thai moenih.
Bibi boeih he amah mikhmuh ah tueng, A mik aka buep pah thai he a om moenih.
A tong lamloh a tue a bawt hil a cungkuem a hmuh thai, A nih hamla khobae rhambae ti a om moenih.
“He tah balae”, “Ke tah balae,” n'ti thai moenih, a cungkuem he a mangtaengnah bangla a suen coeng.
A yoethennah loh khohmuen rhamrhae te tuiva bangla a khuk, Te vaengah tuili bangla boeih a et.
Tedae a kosi loh namtom rhoek te a haek, khohmuen tuiphuet khaw lungkaeh la a poeh sak.
Uepom hamtah longpuei he dueng Tedae halang hamlat tangrhom hoeng la om.
A tong lamtah a then hamla hno then a suen, tedae hlangtholh ham tah hno then khaw a thae pah.
Hlang khosaknah nong a kungpuei la a kuek tah tui neh, hmai neh, thi neh, lungkaeh he Vaidam, suktui neh khoitui, Misur thii, situi neh hnicu he ni.
He boeih he hlangcim ham tah a then pah, Hlang tholh ham la a thae la vik a poeh pah.
Tawnlohnah hamla khohli khaw a saii, Te dongah a thintoek loh tlang khaw a moelh sak. A poeknah hnin ah tah a thaa a huel uh vetih A saikung kah thintoek te paa bitni.
Hmai neh, rhael neh, khokha neh, lucik khaw he boeih he tawnlohnah ham ni a phueng.
Khohong rhamsa kah pumcu neh, saelkhui ta-ai rhulthae neh cunghang loh hlang tholh poci ham dan a tat.
Te long te Boeipa kah pinnah dongah bisai ham a ngaih sak, Diklai dongah a bibi hamla a sikim sak, Te dongah amah tuetang a pha vaengah tah A olpaek te aal uh tlaih voel mahpawh.
Te dongah a moecuek lamloh he boeih ka yakming coeng, te ka poek het coeng tih ca dongah ka khueh.
Boeipa kah bibi tah boeih then, A cungkuem a ngoe tue van vaengah boeih a paek.
U long khaw, “He tah ke lakah then,” ti thai pawh, Hno then amah tuetang vaengah a khueh coeng.
Te dongah na thinko boeih neh, ol neh Koehnah te saa lamtah Boeipa ming te uem laeh.
Bi tloh he hlang boeih ham a suen pah, Adam koca rhoek te hamkun a rhih la a nan. A manu bung lamkah a suntlak paek lamloh, mulhing boeih kah a manu taengla a mael hnin duela.
Thinko ngaihmangnah neh rhihnah he amih ham ni Te dongah a dueknah hnin ah tah a ngai cikcok uh.
Boei ngolkhoel dongah aka ngol rhoek khaw, laivai neh hmaiphu dongah aka kol sut khaw,
Didi himbai neh rhuisam aka khuem lamloh a pawn savawk a pai hlang hil ah khaw,
thintoeknah neh, uetnah neh, ngaihmangnah, mawnnah, dueknah rhihnah neh, tohhaemnah, puenpa khaw om Hlang he a thingkong dongah a yalh vaengah hlaem kah a ih vaengah khaw a ngai cikcok.
Kolkalh khaw duemnah a dang moenih, a ih vaengah khaw khothaih bangla thingthuel uh.
Hil-uepnah vel a pha vaengah vik haenghang, lunglilungla la rhihnah loh a let sak.
Mulhing boeih, hlanghing neh rhamsa taengah om, tedae hlang taengah a pueh voei rhih hilah om.
Dueknah, thii longnah, puenthae neh cunghang khaw, citcai khaw, khokha khaw, pocinah khaw, lucik khaw pai.
He boeih he tah halang ham ni a phueng pah, amik kongah ni diklai khaw tuili loh ana et.

Diklai lamkah tah diklai mael tih, Vaan lamkah tah vaan la mael.   
\b  
\s1 Songrhainah khaw Cikngae mahpawh
Kavelh caaknah neh a thuem pawt tah poci ni, Tedae a then tangnah tah cak yoeyah ni.
A thuem mueh la aka boei khaw tuiva bangla kak, a pocinah khaw hlipuei khuikah rhaeh ol bangla cai.
Moeihoeih hlang tah omngaihnah a coeng sak, Tedae olkhueng a aek rhep poci ni.
Hlangmuen ca rhoek tah a paek yol, a yung khaw koh tih thael rhaep ah kingkaek.
Tuiva tui taengkah carhaek kung tah, a tloe khopol lakah yue a phuk.

Tedae rhennah he tah yoethennah dum bangla om, hlang doedannah he khaw dungyan duela nguel bal.   
\b  
\s1 Omngaih Hingnah
Khuehtawn neh thapang loh khosak a tui sak, tedae thakvoh aka hmuh khaw then ngai bal.

Camoe neh khopuei kah imsak khaw pakhat ming longni a thoh, te lakah khaw cueihnah ka hmu tah then ngai bal. Saelhung neh cangpai loh hlang a boei sak Tedae a yuu khoboe aka then tah te rhoi lakah then.
Misur neh toembael loh ko a hoe sak, Tedae paya lungnah he te rhoi lakah then.
Phavi neh rhotoeng loh laa a tui sak Tedae olding tah te rhoi lakah then.
Mik loh sitlohnah neh sakthen te a nai, tedae cang sai hingsuep tah terhoi lakah then.
Paya neh pueipo he khaw n'doe yoeyah, Tedae yuu aka cueih he te rhoi lakah then ngai.
Huiko neh bomkung he tah ngaihmang tue kah ham ni Tedae doedannah loh te rhoi lakah a then la a hlawt.
Sui neh tangka loh paihmuen a cak sak Cilsuep then tah terhoi lakah a ngaihom ngai.
Boeinah neh thaomnah loh uepangnah a thoh, Tedae Boeipa rhih he te rhoi lakah then ngai.

Boeipa rhihnah tah yoethennah dum la om, thangpomnah lakah hlang a thing a cam ngai.   
\b  
\s1 Rhaidaeng la Kutduennah
Ka ca, na khosak te buhbihnah la khuen boeh, m'bih lakah tah n'duek ham he then ngai.

Hlang loh a hui kah caboei bung a sawt vaengah, a khosak long te khaw khosaknah la a poek moenih. Pakhat long tah hlang kah buh an soah a yah a voeih, Tedae aka cueih neh a thuituen hlang tah amah tuem uh.
Yahdaeng kah a ka ah buhbih khaw a tui pah, Tedae a khuiah tah hmai la a ung pah coeng.
Aw dueknah, nang poeknah khaw khahing mai, A khuehtawn sokah a ngai aka mong taengah, Mawnnah om pawt tih, a soeprhaep kho aka buh taengah, Bi rhang tih buh an ngaikhuek la aka om taengah.

Aw dueknah na oltloek te metlam n'doe lah eh, vawtthoeknah om tih thadueng aka tla taengah tah. Patong loh a kae tih cungkuem aka mawn aka tang, kalthalh la aka om tih thinsennah boeih aka bawt taengah tah.
Nang hamtah dueknah oltloek te khaw rhih boeh, Nang hmai kah aka cet rhoek neh, na hnukah aka lo rhoek te khaw poek.

Hetah pum sa boeih hamla Boeipa kah oltloeknah coeng ni, Balae tih Khohni kah kongaih te na aek mai eh. Hingnah eh kum rha, kum yakhat, kum thawng khat lo sitoe cakhaw, Hell ah rhae n'dawt mahpawh.   
\b  
\s1 Halang kah Yoekam
Hlangtholh kah a ca tah rhalawt ca lam ni a om, amih long te Pathen mingmueh khosak ni a vai uh.
Hlang tholh ca kha a rho ta poci ni, a tiingan khaw a yoeyah hil yah a poh ni.
A napa lailak te a ca rhoek loh a khotohnah ni, anih rhangneh kumhal yah a poh uh van dongah.
Anunae nang lailak rhoek aih, Khohni Pathen kah olkhueng aka voei rhoek aih.
Ca na khueh cakhaw, citcai ni a yaak eh guekcoinah ham ni a mih te na sak eh. Na paloe vaengah omngaih vetih, Na duek te khaw thaephoeinah hmulung la om coeng.
Diklai lamkah na lo bangla diklai la na mael ni, Lailak ngawn tah thaephoeinah lamloh pocinah a paan.
Pilnam long he pumsa dueknah dongah rhap uh, Tedae hlang tholh kah ming thae tah a phae yoeyah ni.
Na ming dongah khaw ngaithuennah khueh, Te tah namah lah muep hing vetih Suitlang a thawng khat lakah khaw oe ngai ni.
Khosak then khohnin tah n'tae thai, Tedae ming then tah a dungyan duela cak.

Ka ca aw, nang n'phaepnah soah a thuem neh rhoepnah neo om. Cueinah a phah neh hmuh mueh kawnthen, melae a phu aka om tloe eh?   
\b  
\s1 Cikcoknah
A cueihnah nah a thuh hlang lakah tah, a angnah aka khoem te then ngai.
Te dongah ka ol dongah hinyahnah tueng sak, A tue takuem yahyongnah he then pawt tih, cikcoknah boeih pom he pom ham om pawh.
Na nu neh na pa mikhmuh ah na cuk na halh te khaw Ukkung mangpa hmaiah na laithae te khaw,
hlangcal laitloek hmai ah na boe te khaw, Pilnam rhaengpuei hmaiah olkhueng na poe khaw, Paya rhoihui hmai ah a thae la na om khaw,
Na om nah kho ah na huen te khaw yak saw. Olkhueh neh olhlo na phae te khaw, Buh kung ah kut na vikvawk soeh khaw, paeknah neh doenah dongah kho la na hmuep khaw,
Nang aka uem taengah ol na mueh khaw, Pumyoi bueng na dan te khaw,
Pacaboeina khaw rhenbihnah na hnawt te khaw, hlang buhham neh kutdoe na mom te khaw, Hlang yuu dongah na yalh te khaw,
A salnu pum dongah om na rhoi te khaw yak saw. A thingkong te khaw paan boeh, Paya hmuh olthae hlah boeh.
Kutdoe na paek hnukah olthae neh pahoi bawt boeh.

Na yaak lalah olhuep na phoe te Na yah ni koep na koei coeng. A tuengta ah na yah khaw na khueh ni te daengah ni pilnam kah kolonah na hmuh eh. A dangkah hno aka om dongah yak boeh, maelhmai a suengnah ham khaw tholhnah saii boeh.
Khohni kah olkhueng neh a paipi dongah khaw, Lailak rhoek soah a tuengta la laitloek ham khaw,
Rhoihui neh yincet puei kah cayin khoem ham khaw paya kah rho caekboe pah ham khaw,
Coi neh colung a thuem khueh ham kha, a yol a yet khaw rhen dang ham khaw,
Thenpomnah lamloh a hoeikhangnah ham khaw, Camoe thuituennah dongah khuituk ham khaw, Sal thae kah a nam ah thii long sak ham khaw,
Uepvawt nu kongah kutha khueh ham khaw, kut a yet nah ah thoh kalh ham khaw yak boeh.
A casai na khueh vaengah rhep tae lamtah loeng dae, na paek tih na doe vaengah khaw ca dongah boeih khueh.

Anglat neh angvawk la ka om khaw, patong uicuk aka tholh khaw toel ham yak boeh. Te daengah ni a thuem thuituenkung na om vetih, hlang boeih loh nang te n'doe eh.   
\b  
\s1 Canu neh Napa
Canu long a huep la a napa a mawntang sak, te dongah a ngaisaknah loh a ih khaw a rhawt pah. A camoe vaengah nim, va sa pawt vet tila lakueng, a rhukom phoeiah nim vik hnoel mai koinih,
A oila bal nim te hlang loh poeih vetih a napa im ah vik vawn ve a ti bal Va a khueh nim te vik hnukpoh koinih, a rhukom phoeiah khaw cakol la om mai koinih ti a rhih.

Canu thinlen te tah khak dawn laeh, Namah te na thunkha taengah aka lawn la om ve. Khopuei neh pilnam rhaengpuei taengah ol n'boep sak vetih, hlangling pasae lakliah namah te yah m'bai ve. A imkhan ah thohhue a om pawt ham so lamtah, a im taengah thohput a om pawt ham khaw dawn.
A hlang then te tongpa hmuh ah tueng sak boeh, amah tue rhukom nu taengah hnonah saeh.
Himbai he khaw keet la poeh thai tih, huta lamloh huta kah a boethae khaw thoeng.

Tongpa kah a halangnah he huta kah boethen lakah phoeng, Huta long he yahpohnah neh mingthae khaw a phueih thai.   
\b  
\s1 Pathen Kutngo
Boeipa kah bibi dongah ka lungbuei a thoel pawn ni Ka hmuh te khaw ka doek pawn ni. Boeipa kah ol loh a bibi te a coeng sak a sai hluen boeih te a kongaih bangla a om sak
Khomik loh a cungkuem te a vangnah ne a hmuh, Te dongah a bibi khaw amah thangpomnah neh bae.

Amah kah kopoekrhai bibi boeih te tae thai hamla a hlangcim pakhat pataeng a thaphoh moenih. Te te Tlungthang Boeipa loh a thoh coeng, te daengah nih lunglai boeih tah, amah thangpomnah dongah a cak eh.
Tangrhom dung neh hlang thinko khaw a khe tih, A khuisaek kah olhuep khaw a yakming. Khohni loh metla a om koi khaw boeih a ming, khosuen lamkah neh aka thoeng ham khaw a hm uh.
Aka om tangtae neh aka om koi te a phoe tih, a huep a hael kah te khaw a tueng sak.
Amah rhael hamkhaw poeknah om pawh, amah taengah pakhat khaw m'phah thai moenih.
A cueinah rhuepomnah te tlueptluep a khueh, Amah tah dungyan lamloh ha thoeng tih amah la om. U long khaw thap pah thai pawt tih yueh pah thai pawh, anih te poeknah paekung la u khaw a kuek moenih.
Boeipa kah bisai boeih tah a nai om tangkik te te sawt vaengah leklek phaa.
He hno boeih tah hing tih dungyan duela om, a ngoenah ah hnonah ha a saihluen te rhip a khoem.
Te boeih te a bok la om tih khat neh lang coeng, A soep mueh la a saii hno he a om moenih.
Pakhat loh pakhat kah a thennah a thap pah, A thangpomnah hmuh ham te u lae aka bong bal pueng?
Sosang koekkah pomsangnah tah vaan khocil ke ni, Vaan mikhmuh kah sawt ham thangpomnah la om bal.
Khomik a thoeng vaengah, amah a thoeng te a phoe, Khohni kah kutngo kopoekrhai tubael om.
Khothun loh khohmuen a vo tih, u long lae kholing kah a do te a noeng thai.
Hmai-ulh dongah bi aka bi te hmailing loh a do, Te lakah khomik loh tlang a do te a pueh pathum la ling. Hmai hu te khaw a phuh tih, khosaeng kah a aa loh mik a dael sak.

Te te aka saii Boeipa tah len tangkik, A olpaek khaw a longpuei cet paitok.   
\b  
\s1 Hla Kah Rhuepomnah
Hla tah khoning a hoi vaengah noeknah la om khonoek a uk tih, dungyan miknoek la om.
Hla dong lamloh khotue hnin kah miknoek khaw om, hla a lum vaengah tah a coengnah khaw soep.

Hla sae khaw, a ming a paek bangla, koep thai, he tla a hoilae khaw khobaerhambae pawn ni. Sosang kah caempuei taengah hmaidi la om tih, vaan kah vaikhap dongah vaang.   
\b  
\s1 Aisi Pampacung kah Rhuepomnah
Aisi kah thangpomnah tah vaan kah sakthennah la om, Boeipa kah hmuen sang a aa loh a tueng sak.
A Cimkoek kah olpaek rhangneh Pai hmuen a hmoel pah dongah rhip pai uh. A bibinah dongah khaw ha sak tlaih pawh.
Pampacung ke so lamtah, te aka suen te koeh lah, a aa dongkah a thennah khaw khuet coeng.

Thangpomnah payaicung bangla vaan ke a hil, Khohni kah kut te a yueng phai.   
\b  
\s1 Lunglai kah Khobaerhambae
A olpek rhangneh vuelsong a tlak sak, Te vaengah a laitloeknah rhaek khaw thui.
Te dongah a khai-im ong uh tih khomong te vaa bangla ding.
Khomai khaw a rhuepomnah rhang thadueng a paek, Te dongah rhaelnu khaw a nuei la boeih rhek.
Amah a thoeng vaengah tlang khaw hinghuen tih, a kongaih rhang neh tuithim yil khaw cu.
A rhaek ol loh diklai a ho vaengah tah, Tlangpuei lamkah hli thae neh humhae halo. Amah loh vuel te vaa aka ding bangla a haeh, kaisih a rhum bangla lukluk khoi.
A bokthik kah a then loh mik phak tue, te a tlak vaengah a lungbuei khaw a ngaihmang.
Diklai ah tuihu te lungkaeh bangla a phul, te vaengah hling ka a hmui bangla a sum.
Tlangpuei yilh ding a caeh vaengah, tui soah khaw tuikhal la khal coeng. Te te tubuem tui boeih dongah a khueh, te dongah tui te rhangpho bangla a poeh sak.
Tlang khaw a hlup tih khosoek khaw a hoeh, rham tlim te khaw hmai bangla a koh sak.
Dotui loh a cungkuem te koe a hoeih sak, Buem a bo vaengah kholing lamloh a hilhoem uh.
A mangtaengnah rhangneh a dung kahw a duem sak, Te dongah a sokah tuisanglak te tloep a hol pah.
Tuipuei hlaikan rhoek loh a rhihom khaw a thui, mamih loh n'yaak vaengah n'ngaihmang uh.
Te khuiah tah aka lang tih kopoekrhai mulhing khaw om, aka hing hno boeih neh tuiham puei khaw om.
Boeipa rhangnen ni a puencawn rhoek khophoeng a pha, A ol rhang neh a cungkuem te a cului bal.
Muep n'thui thai dae a thui n'hah pawh, a hnukkhueng ol lamtah, “Amah tah a cungkuem la om”.
Amah koehnah ham thadueng te melam m'hmuh eh, Amah tah a bibi lakah khaw khuet ngai coeng.
Boeipa tah khuet tih len tangkik, a saithainah khaw khobae rhambae pawn ni.

Boeipa te thangpom lamtah na coengnah boeih neh amah te pomsang lah. Amah long tah a cungkuem khaw a poe, Amah na pomsang vaengah na thayung boeih huel Te vaengah tawnbanah khaw khueh boeh, Boeipa te a hah la na koeh thai pawt ve.
U long a hmuh thai vetih, uh long a thui thai eh, Boeipa a coengnah bangla u long a pomsang thai eh.
A huep kah aka yalh lakah he a len muep om pueng, a bibi dongkah a yol ca ni ka hmuh bal pueng.
Boeipa loh a cungkuem a saii coeng, tedongah Pathen hlang ni cueihnah a paek.
Ming thang hlang rhoek koehnah laa sa uh sih a pa rhoek kah a duengnah dongah khaw.
Boeipa loh amih te thangpomnah len neh, A cuekca lamlah a rhuepomnah te a yo sak.
A ram aka uk khaw ana om tih amamih kah tingtawknah loh amih ham ming a om sak. Lungming hlang loh cilsuep ana thui pa tih, amaih loh tonghma olrhuh khaw a phong uh.
A cilsuep rhangneh pilnam ana mawt, Amih mingnah rhangneh pilnam a lungcuei, Amih tah olka uentonah dongah khaw cueih uh,
Amih te phungding oldi la a khueh tih Amih tah tingtoenglung la a daek.
Boei hlang loh a kawn te a soem tih, a imkhuiah ngaimong la kho a sak.
Te boeih te a cadilcahma duela a hiyah uh tih, Amah tue vaengah khaw a oep uh.
Amih khuikah hlangvan loh a ming a caehtak, te dongah a tloe loh amih koehnah te a phong.
Tedae a ngen tah poekkoepnah om voel pawh, a om pawt hnukah tah poeknah khaw hmata, Amih te aka thang pawt hlang bangla, Amih hnukah a ca aka khueh pawt bangla om.
Tedae amih khaw Pathen kah hlang rhoek ni, Amih hlangdueng rhoek kah khoboe tah n'hnilh moenih.
Amih kah khuehtawn te a cadilcahma taengah om vetih, a rho te khaw a ca kah a ca patong taengah om ni.
A cadil khaw paipi tongah pai tih, A ca rhoek khaw amih ham ni a om.
A tiingan tah a yoeyah la pha uh veih, amih thangpomnah ta paa tlaih mahpawh.
A pum tah mongnah khuiah a up uh dae a ming tah cadilcahma phoeikah cadilcahma duela hing
Rhaengpuei loh amih kah cueihnah a phong uh, Hlangping loh amih koehnah te a doek uh.
Enok tah Boeipa loh a uem tih a loh, cadilcahma boeih taengah yutnah miknoek la om.
Noah tah hlang soep neh hlangdueng la phoe, kosi tue vaengah aka hing namtu la a khoem. Tuili halo vaengah anih tah, Diklai ah a meet la a khueh.
Anih taengah dungyan paipi a saii tih, Pumsa hing boeih te tuili loh et voel pawh.
Abraham tah namtom hlangping kah pa puei la om, thangpomnah dongah tah anih bangla om noek pawh.
Khohni kah olkhueng te a kuem coeng dongah anih neh paipi khuila a kun puei. Anih loh amah saa te moi la a nawn dongah, a noem het coeng tih uepom la a pom.

Boeipa loh anih taengah olhlo a cak sak, a cadil dong lamloh natom rhoek a yoethen. Anih tah diklai ah laipi yet la a ping sak tih, a tiingan te aisi bangla a pom sang. Amih te tupuei lamloh tuipuei hil rho a phaeng tih, Perath lamloh diklai khobawt hil a ping sak.
Isaak khaw a napa Abrahma rhangneh, ngaikhueknah a paek coeng. Pilnam boeih kah yoethennah neh paipi tah

Jakob lu dongah a tlak sak. Anih te a yoethennah neh a ming tih, a rho te a taengah a paek. A buhham khaw a moe nih, koca hlainit taengah a tael pah. Anih cadil khuiah Boeipa loh Pathen hlang a thoeng sak, anih tah hlang boeih mikhmuh ah mikdaithen la om.
Anih te Pathen neh Pilnam loh a lungnah, Mose aka poek a yoethen.
Boeipa loh anih te thangpomnah khuiah hlangcim vanat la a khueh anih te a tanglue sak dongah a thunkha loh a rhih,
A ol dongah minoek khaw tlek a saii, Anih te Boeipa loh manghai rhoek hmaiah a thangpom. Boeipa loh anih te pilnam hamla olkhueng a paek, anih taengah a thangpomnah a tueng sak.
A uepomnah neh kodonah dongah anih te a poek, hlanghing khuiah anih khoem a coelh.

Anih bueng te a ol a yaak sak tih, amah te khomong khomai khuila a khuen, Olkhueng a paek vaengah a hmai neh a hmai hum uh, te ah hingnah neh mingnah olkhueng rhoe pai ni. Te tlam ni Jakob kah paipi te a cangpuei vetih, a oltloeknah te Israel taengah a thuituen eh.
Boeipa loh Aaron a pomsang, hlang cim Moses bangla anih tah a manuca pai tih Levi koca khuikah ni.
Anih taengah khaw dungyan paipi a sai, anih te pilnam kah khosoih la a khueh. Boeipa loh anih te rhim-om la yoethen a paek tih, a pum dongah thangpomnah himbai a bai sai.
Anih te rhuepomnah te a soep a bai sak tih, saithainah miknoek neh a thaphoh.
Anih te tale thaih neh a yen tih, sui hlingthung muep a bang pah. A caeh vaengah hlingthung ol lo tih, a cai te bawkim khuiah a yaak uh. Te tah pilnam rhalrhingnah aka pae la om.
A cim himbai te sui neh a cangul neh, daidi neh aemkaek kah kutngo neh, Laitloeknah olrhuh neh, Urim neh, Thummim neh
Kuthai kah bibi neh a ling la a en tih kutnoek la a tarhit lung vang neh, Lungthen aka saii kah sui rhaiphuel neh, Israel koca te rhip poeknah ca khaw a tarhit.
A lupong soah sui rhuisam a khuem tih, “Cimcaihnah” kutha te a khueh pah. A khuetnah kutdoe, bibi a thoemnah la a mik dongah mikcuk la, muep a thoeihcam.
Anih hlan ah tebang hnothen a om noek moenih, Rhamvoel hlang khaw a bai sak noek moenih Tedae Aaron koca rhoek neh, a cadil taengah ni a khuui la a khueh.
Boeipa kah hmueh te a pum la a phum tih hnin takuem ah hnavoei hnavoei phat a phum.

Moses loh anih te a koelh anih te situi cim neh a koelh. Te tah anih ham kumhal kah paipi la om, Vaan a om khuiah tah a cadil rhoek ham kha a om pah. Boeipa ka bibikung la khosoih a bi sak tih, anih ming rhangneh pilnam a yoethen.
Mulhing boeih khuiah khaw Boeipa loh anih a coelh, pilnam ham tholh dawthnah aka khueh kung hamla.
A olpaek kahw anih taengah ni a paek, saithainah neh, olrhi khaw, laitloeknah khaw. Olphong te Jakob taengah aka cangpuei la, a olkhueng neh Israel mik aka tueng sak hamla.
Rhamvoel rhoek loh anih te a uevawt uh khosoek ah anih te a uet uh. Dathan neh Abiram kah a hnukbang rhoek loh Khosi neh thintoeknah khuiah Korah rhoihui long khaw.
Boeipa loh a hmuh vaengah a kolo pawh, Te dongah Boeipa kah thingtoek hmailing loh amih te a phae, Boeipa loh kopoekrhai hno a saii tih, amih te hmaisai hmai loh boeih a hlawp.
Aron tah thangpomnah koep a thap pah, Te dongah anih te rho neh a phaeng. Anih te thaih cuek tanglue a yo sak tih, thaih cuek buh te muep a tawn pah.
Boeipa kah hmueih a caak uh te, amah neh a cadilcahma taengah a pang sak.
Tedae anih pilnam kah khohmuen a pang sak moenih, Pilnam lakli ah khoyo khaw a khueh moenih. Boeipa amah te anih ham rho neh khoyo la om coeng.

Eleazar capa Phinehas tah thangpomnah dongah a pathum nah la om Anih tah Boeipa rhinah dongah khaw tlungmu. Pilnam boeih a hnukpoh vaengah a cak la pai, a hinglu longkhaw hlangtang kah rhalthennah a khueh, Te dongah Israel hamla tholh dawthnah a khueh pah.
Anih taengah paya kah paipi khaw a thoh pah tih, hmuencim neh a pilnam kah mawtkung la a khueh. Amah neh a cadil rhoek khaw kumhal kah, khosoih rhim-om la a om sak.
Judah koca Jeseecapa David taengah paipi a thoh vanbangla, Manghai rho te a ca lamloh a ca taengah a paek, te dongah Aaron kah rho tah amah cadil ham a khueh pah.

Te dongah Boeipa te uem uh laeh, Amah loh thangpomnah n'khuem sak coeng. Boeipa loh nang te kopoek cueihnah m'pae saeh. Pilnam te tiktamnah neh laitloek hamla. Te daengah a khobuhnah khaw a paa pawt vetih a cadilcahma taeng duela amih thangpomnah te a nguel eh.

Nun capa Joshua tah caemtloek dongah tlung pai Anih tah tonghma bibi dongah Moses hnukthoi la om. Anih tah a ming dongkah a om tih Pathen hlang tuek kah khangkung boei la om. Amih aka tlai thil a thunkha soah tawnlonah a khueh. Te dongah Israel taengah rho a tael pah.
A kut a thueng vaengah khuet tangkik tih, a cunghang loh khopuei rhoek khaw a saih.
Anih hlang unim a cak la aka pai? anih tah Boeipa ham ni caem a tloek.
Anih rhangneh khomik khaw duem tih, hnin at mai te hnin nit bangla p uh.
Thunkha la hnukhmai la a nen vaengah, anih long Samrhang Khohni ni a khue. Te dongah Boeipa boeilen loh anih te, tlungthang thaomnah rhaelnu neh a voek.

Caemtloek vaengah namtom khaw thup tih, tuibah ah a thinnaek rhoek khaw a thup. Te dongah namtom loh anih kah caemtloeknah khaw a ming. Anih tah Boeipa mikhmuh a vathoh tih, Tlungthang hnukah bang hamla tlungmu.

Joshua tue vaengah anih khaw, Jephunneh capa Kaleb khaw Moses loh hlangtang la a khueh coeng. Anih loh hlangping khaw a oelh tih Pilnam te tholhnah lamloh a hlawt. Te vaengah amih kah halangnah te dup a hnah.
Camoe thawng ya rhuk khuiah tah sueng rhoi, Te dongah pilamnah rhopangnah khuila a khuen. Te khohmuen ah suktui neh khoitui khaw long.
Boeipa loh Kaleb te thadueng a paek, Te te a patong hil amah taengah om, Te dongah tlang ram la cet tih, a cadil ham rho la a khueh pah.
Te dongah Israel pum loh hmu van saeh, Boeipa hnuk aka bang kah a then tangkik te.
Laitloekkung rhoek khaw a ming hinyahnah kap amih kah thinko tah mueirhol taengah a hoi moenih, Boeipa taeng lamloh taengphael uh pawt, amih poekkoepnah tae a yoethen pai.
A rhuh pataeng a yalhnah kung lamloh, a thai la a hingnah koep a om khaw, hinyah aka kap rhoek a ming te khaw, a ca rhoek taeng duela koep om saeh.
Samuel tah Boeipa loh a thintlonah Boeipa tonghma la om tih ram a pai sak, Pilnam ukkung rhoek te khaw a koelh.
Boeipa kah olkhueng bangla rhaengpuei lai a tloek, Boeipa loh Jakob te a dawndah.
A uepomnah soah anih te tonghma la a pom, a olthui dongah anih te uepom khohmu la a ming.
Anih te voeivang kah rhal loh a nen vaengah, Samrhang Boeipa te a khue tih, Tu sukyawn te hmueih la a nawn.
Boeipa loh vaan lamkah rhaek a hlak tih ol a cai sak vaengah rhihom ol a yaak uh.
Anih loh a thunkha kah mawtkung rhoek neh, Philistine mawt kung rhoek khaw boeih a hlak.
Dungyan a ih tue a pha tom vaengah, Boeipa neh a koelh hlang hmai laipai la om, Khokhom yungnit khaw a yet hnopai khaw, pakhat taengkah ka loh nim?” a ti vaengah. Anih aka boe sak te a om moenih.
A ihnah kungla a yalh phoeiah khaw tonnghma tih manghai dueknah te a thui. Lairhi lamloh ol a huel tih, a olphong loh hlang thae te boeih a khoe.
Samuel phoeiah tah Nathan phoe, David tue vaengah ol a phong.
Hmueih pumsoep dong lamkah a tha a hoep bangla, Israel khui lamloh David te hloep a coelh coeng.
Sathueng te maae ca bangla, Vom khaw tuping tuca bangla a luemnah.
A camoe ah a le khaw a ngawn tih, pilnam kah yahpohnah te khoe het pawt nim? Me vaengah lae payai neh lungcang a hil tih, Hlang hoem Goliath te mat a dae?
Anih long tah Boeipa, Khohni ni a khue, Te dongah a bantang kut te thadueng a paek. Te vaengah hlangtlung hlangrhalh khaw a tloek tih, pilnam kah saithainah te a pomsang.
Te dongah anih tah thawngrha khaw a noeng tila a thangpom, Boeipa loh yoethennah a khueh pa soah anih a koeh uh, Thangpomnah rhuisam te khaw anih a khuem sak uh bal
Kaepvai boeih kah a thunkha te a khoe tih, A rhal Philistine khaw a thup dongah Mamih kah khohnin duela amih te paep uh.
A saii boeih soah khaw A Cim Khohni, te a uemtih amah thangpomnah te a doek. Koehnah laa khaw a thinko boeih neh sak, Amah aka suenkung te khaw a lungnah.
Hmueihtuk hmaiah laasa rhoek khaw a khueh tih, Amih ol dongah phungding olding a khueh sak.
Amah loh khotue ham khaw sawthennah a khueh, Kum khat ham a tue boeih a soepsoei bal, Pathen kah a ming cim te a koeh uh vaengah, hmuencim tah mincang lamloh yue tuenpa coeng.
Boeipa loh a tholnah te a loh pah tih, a thaomnah te a yoeyah la a pomsang, Anih taengah manghai paipi neh, Israel kah thangpomnah ngolkhoel a paek.
Anih hnukah capa hlangcueih koep phoe, Anih rhangneh bidip la kho a sak uh.
Solomon longtah rhalmongnah tue neh a manghai thil, Pathen loh a khorhi boeih ah rhalmongnah a khueh. Te daengah nih Boeipa ming te im a sak thai eh, Te dongah a rhokso te a yoeyah la a pai sak.
Na camoe vaengah mah na cueih tangkik tih, yakmingnah te tuiva bangla na long coeng.
Na tangluenah te diklai tom ah yilh cet. Nang tah olcueih thuingaihnah aka dung neh a baetawt.
Na mingthang loh khohla sanglak a pha tih, Rhoepnah neh na manghai dongah nang te n'lungnah.
Na laa khaw, na olcueih neh thuidoeknah khaw, Na hlatnah loh namtom khaw kopoekrhai a paek.
Boeipa Pathen ming rhangneh, Israel Pathen aka khue la om. Sui khaw thi bangla na kol tih, Ngun khaw kawnlawk bangla na hmoek.
Tedae na taengah aka yalh la yuu te na loh, Tedongah na pum te boengai oeng la na khueh.
Na rhuepomnah te dawih na koelh tih, na im ko te boeih na poeih. Te dongah na ca rhoek khaw kosi na loh pah, na ang dongah amih te nguekcoi uh.
Na poengnah ram khaw rhek tih, Epharaim lamkah a poe loh ram a tloelh.

Tedae Boeipa loh a rhennah te hlahpham pawh, a bibi te poci sak hamla pakhat khaw khueh pawh. A coelh cadil he tah khoe tlaih mahpawh, A lungnah hlang kah im ko te bit mahpawh. Jakob kah a meet te a khueh tih, a imkhui kah a yung lamloh David a poek sak.

Solom te a napa rhoek taengla duem, Te vaengah a ca rhoek te a caehtak, a cueih talh tih a ang ni a yaal Rehohoam, anih kah khoboe loh pilnam boe a koek sak. Nebat capa Jeroboam loh Israel te tholh khuila a mawt, Tholhnah longpuei Epharaim a tong sak.
Amih kah tholhnah te ta-oe ta-oe pungtai, a khohmuen lamloh saldong la a khuen hil.
Halang koi boeih te a tlap uh, amih soah tawnlohnah a pai duela.
Tonghma Elijah tah hmai bangla a thoeng, A olthui khaw hmaithoi bangla tak.
Amih soah khokhanah a pai sak tih, a kohlopnah loh amih a hlangmi a muei sak.
Boeipa ol rhangneh vaan khaw a biing tih, a rhaepthum la hmai a tlak sak.
Elijah nang tah na khuet tangkik, Na khoboe te khobae rhambae pawn ni. U kah thangpomnah longnim nang kah te a tluk.
Nang loh rhok te dueknah lamkah khaw, Saelkhui lamkh khaw, Khohni kah olka rhangneh na thoh coeng.
Manghai rhoek te cungkunah khuila na tueih tih, Mingthang hlang khaw a thingkong dongah na duek sak.
Sinai kah a honah neh Horeb kah, Tawnloh laitloeknah khaw na yaak.
Pilnam tholh thungnah aka khueh manghai hoek, nang aka pang ham tonghma rhoek khaw na koelh.
Nang tah hmai humhae neh, hmai marhang leng loh n'loh coeng.
A tue a pha vaengah thintoek thinsa neh, Pathen kah kosi aka paa sak hamla, A napa rhoek kah thinko te a ca rhoek taengah mael sak ham Jakob koca te thoh sak ham m'hmoel te a daek coeng.
Nang aka hmuh tih lungnah neh, aka thoeihcam rhoek tah a yoethen uh. Te dongah rhep ka hing uh van pawn ni.

Elijah te hmumha loh a cun vaengah, Elisha tah a mueihla neh baetawt, Miknoek khaw rhaepnit la muep a saii, a ka dongkah khobaerhambae la thoeng. Amah tue vaengah tah ukkung hmaiah khaw thuen pawt tih, u long khaw anih te hnaep thai tlaih moenih.
Anih ham tah a kuel a ka khaw om pawh, a duek phoeiah pataeng a rhok te tonghma pueng.
A hing vaengah kopoek rhai a saii tih A dueknah dongah khaw a khoboe te kopoek rhai la om.

Te lallah pataeng pilnam he yut pawt tih, a tholhnah te hnawt uh pawh. Amih te a khohmuen lamloh kutbuem la a poelyoe tih, diklai pum ah a thaek a yaak uh lalah khaw. Pilnam te hlangmi a yool bueng a paih uh tih, Daivi imkhui lamkah ukkung bueng te dawk om.
Hlangvang loh a thuem tah a saii, Tedae a tloe rhoek tah ta-aep, ta-aep tholh uh.
Hezekiah lo a khopuei te a cak sak tih, A tlaklung ah tui a loei. Lungpang khaw thicung neh a vueh tih, Tui hamla tui-im a saii.
Anih tue ah Sennakherib loh ram a muk pah, Te dongah rhalkap a tueih tih nong uh. A kuthluem neh Zion a tlai thil tih, a mangkhaknah neh hoem muep a sat.
Te dongah Israel tah a thinko tuen tih a kut thuen, Te vaengah huta bungltloh bangla kopang uh.
Tedae amih tah rhennah aka khueh Boeipa ni a khue uh Boeipa taengah ni a kut te a phuel uh. A Cim Pathen loh amih ol te vaan lamkah a yaak, Te dongah Isiah rhangneh amih te a loeih sak.
Boeipa loh Assyria kah rhaehhmuen te a tloek tih, A puencawn loh a mih te boeih a khoe.
Hezekiah loh Boeipa loh a ngaih te a saii tih, A napa David kah khosing te a cak la a khoem. Amah te a mangthuinah dongah uepomnah neh, a tanglue la aka om Isaiah loh rhep a uen coeng.
Isaiah tue vaengah khomik khaw a hnuk la mael, te dongah manghai kah a hinglung khaw a tom pah.
Mueihla thincaknah rhangneh hmailong khaw a hmuh tih, Zion kah rhungrhahnah te khaw koep a hloep.
A bawtnah tue mebang a thoeng ham khaw a phoe tih, Olhueng khaw a phoe hlanah boeih a thui.
Josiah kah ming tah botui ka saii thai loh a hmoel, Hmueihmuei botui a thungnom bangla la om. Anih poekkoepnah he hlang ka ah khoitui bangla didip, yukung buhkung kah phungding ol bangla om.
A thuem he a saii tih pilnam a tlaih a vong, Te vaengah halang kah tueilaehkoi ne boeih a khoe.
A thinko khaw Boeipa taengah rhep a khueh, cungpoeh halang tue te Pathen khoboe neh a uk.
David, Hezekiah neh Josiah phoeiah tah, a tloe boeih he hlangtholh koek la om uh. Khohni kah olkhueng te a hno uh dongah, Judah manghai rhoek tah a palthamnah la poeh.
Amih kah thaomnah te hlang tloe taengla, amih thangpomnah te namtom kholong taengla a paek.
Jeremiah kut dongah a thui bangla, a coelh hmuencuen khopuei te a hoeh pah tih, longpuei caetung te khopong la a khueh pah.
Amih loh Jeremiah te khaw a hnaemtaek uh, Anih te a manu bung khuiah Boeipa loh a ciim coeng, aka phu ham, a tulh ham neh aka phae ham khaw, a thoh ham te koep aka phung ham khaw.
Ezekial loh thangpomnah mangthui a hmuh, Pathen loh anih cherubim kah a ngol sak.
Boeipa loh Job te khaw a thui, anih tah tiktamnah longpuei te khak a tuuk.
Tonghma hlainit kah a rhuh khaw thui saeh, te rhoek a yalh nah lamloh hingnah thai khaw om. Te rhoek loh Jakob kah pilnam te a hloep, ngaiuepnah thenkoek neh amih te a hlawt.
Zeubbabel te metlam n'koeh lah eh, anih tah bantang kut kah kuha kutcin banghui ni.
Te phoeiah Jozadak capa Jeshua he khaw, amih tue vaengah im a sak uh tih. Boeipa kah bawkim cim khaw a thoh dongah dungyan thangpomnah la a khueh.
Manghai hnukkhueng Nehemiah khaw poekkoepnah om saeh, anih loh votung aka bung tangtae koep a thoh, Vongka khaw koep a khueh tih thohkalh a saii, mamih kah imkhui aka bung tangtae koep a thoh bal.
Diklai hmanah Enoch bangla ana suen hlan, anih tah diklai lamloh vik a pom sang coeng.
Joshep bang he pakhat thang vai pawh, Te dongah a rhuh khaw a then la a khoem uh,
Shem, Seth neh Enosh khaw hinyah kap, Adam tah a suen mulhing boeih khuiah tanglue la om.
A manuca kah boeilu neh a pilnam kah oekpueinah, Khosoih boei Onias capa Simon, Amah tue vaengah im te a tlaih tih, amah tue vaengah bawkim te a cak sak.
Pangbueng a sang rhaepnip ham khoengim a tloeng tih, bawkim vongup ham vongtung te a khueh.
Anih tue vaengah tuito khaw a to, tui-im dongkah mah mah tuitunli bangla omthen.
A pilnam te pocinah khui lamloh metla hlawt ham khaw a poek, te dongah khopuei te tanglung neh a cak sak.
Pilnam loh anih boyong vaengah bahoeng a rhuepom, himbaiyan im lamkah puk aka thoeng bangla.
Khoboei soah aisi thuipa bang la, Khoning khotue vaengkah hla lum bangla,
Khohni bawkim dongah aka saeh khomik bangla, rhuepom khomai dongah aka yaal pampacung bangla,
Thaihcuek hnin kah rhaipai bangla, Sokca tuikaeng kah tuili pai bangla, Khohal tue kah Lebanon tlang ah aka daih bael hing bangla,
Botui bael dongkah hmai neh hmueihtui bangla, Sui a boh thil bael yak bangla,
A thaih loh a nan olive thing bangla, khomai aka tok hang hmaical thing bangla.
Thangpom himbai a bai vaengah, amah te rhuepom soep neh khuk uh. Hmueihtuk cim la a yoeng vaengah, rhokso tolhmuen te thangpomnah a khueh.

Khosoih kut dongah maehham a doe vaengah, hmueituk kah a lung ah pai. Te vaengah a taengvai kah manuca te rhaihulh bangla amah tah Lebanon kah lamphai thinghloe bangla om. Rhophoe kung bangla a vael uh bal.
A rhuepomnah khuiah Aaron koca rhoek om, a kut dongah Boeipa nawnnah te a khueh tih, Israel hlangping boeih kah hmai ah pai uh.
Hmueihtuk kah bibinah a coeng tih, Khohni tlungthang taengah nawnnah te soepsoei.
A kut te a yueng tih boengloeng a loh, Misur thii te tuisih la a doeng. Hmueihtuk kho te a bueih tih, Cungkuem kah manghai Khohni te hmueihtui a uem sak
Te vaengah Aaron koca rhoek yuhui tih, Thi neh a saii olueng te a ueng uh. Khohni hmai ah yaksaknah hamla ollen olthang a cai sak uh.
Te vaengah pilnam boeih te koe tingtun uh, a maelhmai te cirhong la a buluk uh tih, Khohni Pathen tlungthang, Amih kah Boeipa te a bawk uh.
Te phoeiah laasa rhoek loh Boeipa te a ol neh, olding olthen boeih neh a koeh uh.
Te vaengah pilnam boeih loh Boeipa Khohni Lungvat kung hmaiah thangthuinah te a nawn uh. Boeipa bawknah hmakhuen te a bawt hlan hil a thothuengnah te a soep sak uh.
Te phoeiah tah Simon te suntla a kut a phuel, Israel ca hlangping boeih soah te. Te phoeiah Boeipa kah yoethennah te aka neh a phong, Boeipa ming te thangpomnah a khueh.
Te dongah bawknah khuiah pabae la bakop uh tih, Khohni taeng lamkah yoethennah te a doe uh.
Cungkuem kah Pathen tah a yoethen pai saeh, Kho takuem ah kopoekrhai tangkik la bibi a saii. Ithang lamloh n'rhoengnah hil amah n'cuncah tih, a sitlohnah neh mamih taengah han saii.
Amah loh thiko kohoenah m'pae saeh lamtah, Mamih tue vaengah rhalmongnah om saeh. Khosue Israel tue vaengkah bangla.
A rhennah he mamih taengah han khueh saeh, mamih tue ah khaw amah loh n'loeih sak saeh.
Namtu panit tah ka hinglu loh a hnoel, a pathum kah tah pilnam voel moenih.
Te rhoek tah Seir neh Philistine kah khosa rhoek, Sekhem kah khosa pilnam hlang ang rhoek ni.
Yakmingnah neh mingnah dongah thuituennah te, He cabu dongah ka daek coeng. Jersalem kah Sirach koca Eleazar capa Jesuh he, amah lungbuei ah cueihnah a lun pah dongah ni.
He kah olkah amah aka ngaithuen tah a yeothen, a thinko ah aka rhaehrhong sak hlang cueih ni.
Te te vai hamla aka khueh rhoek tah, mebang hno dongah khaw vanat la om uh vetih, Boeipa rhihnah te amih kah namtlak la om ni.
\s1 \sc Sirach Kah Thangthuinah\sc*
Boeipa Manghai namah te kan uem, Ka Pathen neh ka khangkung nang kan koeh, Namah ming te ka uem.

Namah tah kai tungaepkung neh bomkung la na om, Kai he pocinah khui lamloh kan nan hlawt, Oltha kaling kah a tung hlaeh dong lamkah neh, Laithae thainawn hmuilai lamkah khaw. Kocaelh kah mikhmuh ah kai bomkung la nan hlawt.
Na rhennah neh na ming a len tangkik dongah, Kai he ngaeh ham no aka rhueng rhoek taeng lamkah khaw, ka hngnah aka tlap rhoek kut lamkah khaw, ngaihmangnah rhaepnit la ka ming khui lamkah khaw,
Kaepvai boeih kah hmai rhong khui lamkah khaw, Ka toih mueh kah hmai tak khui lamkah khaw,
Saelkhui bungko a dung khui lamkah khaw, a cim pawh ol neh laithae ol lamkah khaw,
Hlang loh manghai taengla laithae ol a thui khui lamkah khaw Ka hinglu he dueknah neh yoei tih, Ka hingnah he saelkhui khuirhai ah om coeng.
Amih loh loh a hnukhmai la khoep m'vael uh, Te vaengah kai bomkung pakhat khaw om pawh. Hlang kah bomcennah ka lamtawn dae, Pakhat khaw a om moenih.
Boepa nangkah rhennah ni ka poek, A rhuem lamkah na sitlohnah te khaw. Namah aka rhing hlang tah na hlawt tih, amih te a thunkha kut lamloh na khang coeng.
Te dongah diklai lamkah ka thangthuinah kan tueih, dueknah khui lamloh hlawt hamla kan bih.
Boeipa nang ni kan khue, nang kai napa ni, Ngaihmangnah khohnin ah kai n'hnoo boeh. Aka hoem rhoek mikhmuh ah bomkung ka khueh moenih.
Na ming te phat ka koeh vetih, Uemnah laa te ka sak ni.

Ka thangthuinah te na yaak coeng, Pocinah khui lamloh kan nan khang coeng. Ngaihmang tue vaengah kai nan hlawt coeng. He kongah ni nang kan uem tih nang te kan koeh, Te dongah Boeipa ming te Ka uem. BOEIPA te uem lah, amah tah then tih, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Pathen koehnah te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah Israel dawndah kung te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Hno cungkuem aka hlom aka bol amah te uem lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Israel tlankung te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. A taekyak tangtae Israel koep aka coi uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. A khopuei neh a rhokso koep a thoh te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. David imkhui hamla ki aka cawn sak te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Khosoih la Zadok koca aka coelh te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Abrahma kah photling te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Isaak kah lungpang te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Jakob kah tlungthang te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Zion aka coelh te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Manghai rhoek kah Manghai te uem uh lah, a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. A pilnam hamla ki aka thoh te uem uh lah a sitlohnah tah cak yoeyah. Israel ca rhoek, a pilnam te amah ham ni, BOEIPA te koeh uh lah
Ka camoe vaengah pataeng, ka yincaeh hlan ah, Thangthuinah dongah cueihnah phaeng ka tlap.
Bawkim hmaiah cueihnah te ka toem tih, a bawtnah hil cueihnah te ka khe.
Misur a muem laloh a hmin duela, ka thinko he cueinah dongah hmae. Ka kho he namtlak dueng ah cet ih, ka coem lamloh cueinah kholaeh te ka thuih.
Ka hna vel ka kaeng vaengah cueihnah ka dang kai ham thuituennah la muep ka hm uh.
Cueihnah dongah cumphoek tih, Cueinah aka pae kung te thangpomnah ka khueh.
Cueinah bangla khosak long ka rhoek tih, a then dongah kocuknah ka khueh.
Ka hinglu he cueinah neh ka cun tih, ka omih dongah khaw ka cik. Ka kut he vaan la ka phuel, cueinah ka hnoel dongah te ka rhap.
Ka hinglu he cueihnah taengla ka hooi, a cim dongah ni cueihnah te ka hm uh. Cueihnah rhangneh lamhma kah yakmingnah ka dang, te dongah kai he n'hnoo tlaih voel mahpawh.
Cueihnah tlap ham na thinko niknuk coeng, te dongah khuetawnnah kutdoe ka dang.
Boeipa loh ka olka he thapang la m'paek, te dongah ka ol neh amah te ka koeh ni.
Aka cueih mueh nang kai taengla ha yoei lah, Thuituennah im ah he luei uh lah.
Balae tih hebang mai he ka vawt thoek na ti, balaeti te bangla tuihalh te puet na ueh.
Ka ka ka nang tih ka thui coeng, cueihnah he cocip uh lah, nangmih ham tangka a kuek moenih.
Cueihnah hamkun na rhawn ah vah lah, Na hinglu loh thuituennah te doe saeh, Te te a yoei ah ni rhep a om.
Na mik nen khaw hmu van lah, ka thakthae dae a yol ni, mongnah he kamah loh muep ka dang coeng,
Ka thuituennah he a yol mah hnatun van lah, ka dong lamloh sui neh ngun he na dang ni.
Na hinglu te Pathen sitlohnah dongah omngaih saeh, amah koeh ham te me vaengah khaw yak boeh.
A tue then vaengah na bi te saii Pathen mah kah a tue ah, na thapang m'paek bitni.
